title: introduce-tenant-scoped-kms-claims-and-audit-coherence-middleware
author: Aisha Ramos
description:
Motivation: customers have asked for stronger guarantees that tenant-scoped service accounts can only request KMS operations for keys provisioned in their pinned region, and that every KMS call is traceable back to an immutable audit envelope. This PR adds a lightweight coherence middleware (coherence-mw) in the API gateway and a small runtime enforcement shim to bind tenant claims -> KMS key hints -> audit envelope IDs.

What this does (high-level): coherence-mw normalizes incoming identity claims (service_account + tenant_id + region_hint), validates tenant KMS entitlement via the policy engine (uses existing tenant_policy cache), injects a canonical kms_key_hint header when appropriate, and emits an audit_envelope_id that the downstream KMS proxy and audit pipeline use to correlate logs. The runtime shim enforces region pin for KMS token allocation (early reject if mismatch), and RBAC v2 mappings are extended to include service-account-scoped roles for tenant-bounded operations.

Design notes: the middleware intentionally avoids key material management; it only attaches a signed hint (key ARN hint signed with service gateway key) plus a residency assertion token from the policy engine. The audit_envelope_id is generated deterministically from tenant_id + request_nonce + epoch and signed to prevent tampering; the audit pipeline already accepts this envelope format after a small parser upgrade (included). The RBAC mapper changes add a new principal type "tenant_service_account" and a deterministic role expansion rule that prefers tenant-scoped roles over org-wide fallbacks.

Compatibility and rollout: feature guarded behind a runtime flag (feature.tenant_kms_coherence). Default behavior unchanged. We plan a staged rollout: enable in staging, monitor audit-correlations/latency for 48 hours, then enable canary in us-west-2. The PR includes a migration note for operators to seed tenant_policy cache with residency-assertions when enabling.

Testing and validation: unit tests for middleware, policy cache mocks, integration test that exercises a full request path (gateway -> runtime shim -> kms-proxy -> audit-collector). Added an end-to-end test that asserts the audit_envelope_id is present and the kms_key_hint matches the tenant_policy mapping.

Checklist: [x] Add middleware and shim [x] Extend RBAC v2 mapper [x] Add audit envelope parser [x] Add tests and CI jobs [x] Add release notes entry [x] Add Linear links and rollout plan

Related: builds on ENG-10234 (tenant policy cache improvements) and SEC-2045 (KMS entitlement evaluation).
